mapper.sql: i.id, i.seller_id, i.category_id, i.title, i.description, i.price, i.original_price, i.condition_level, i.cover_img, i.campus, i.status, i.audit_remark, i.view_count, i.favorite_count, i.deleted, i.create_time, i.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT , c.name AS category_name, u.nickname AS seller_name, u.avatar AS seller_avatar FROM tb_item i LEFT JOIN tb_category c ON c.id = i.category_id LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.id = i.seller_id WHERE i.id = #{id} AND i.deleted = 0
